channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Questionado sobre 'Dark Horse', Flávio diz que Lulinha deve explicações
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the 'Dark Horse' movie case is 'turned page' and demanded explanations from Lula and his son Lulinha. He declined to elaborate on the film details but used the issue to attack political opponents.

item.title: Todos que cometem crime deve ser punidos, diz Caiado sobre impeachment de ministros do STF
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, stated that anyone who commits a crime, regardless of the branch of government they belong to, must be punished. He made this remark during an event with entrepreneurs in São Paulo, addressing potential impeachment of Supreme Court ministers.

item.title: Além do ambiente doméstico: o que muda com decisão do STF que ampliou as medidas protetivas da Lei Maria da Penha
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court unanimously expanded protective measures under the Maria da Penha Law, allowing women victims of violence to seek protection even without a domestic, family, or emotional relationship with the aggressor. The ruling extends legal coverage to cases in community, professional, institutional, or electoral settings, grounded in the premise that the violence is motivated by the victim's gender. The case originated from a decision by the Minas Gerais Court of Justice that denied protective measures to a woman in a similar situation.

item.title: Tarcísio minimiza neutralidade do Centrão na disputa presidencial
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas downplayed the neutrality of center parties in the presidential race, attributing it to party leaders' interest in forming local caucuses. He advocated for political reform, including district voting and term limits, criticizing the country's loss of consensus-building capacity.

item.title: O Peso da Lei: série sul-africana da Netflix é adaptação de Irmandade
item.description: The Brazilian Netflix series Irmandade has been adapted into a South African version titled Umthetho (The Weight of the Law), released on August 14, preserving core elements while incorporating local context. The crime drama, created by Pedro Morelli, follows lawyer Cristina torn between the police and her brother Edson's criminal faction, portrayed by Seu Jorge.

item.title: Vice de Flávio convida Lira para agenda de campanha em Alagoas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, Alfredo Gaspar, announced he will invite Arthur Lira to a campaign agenda in Alagoas on August 25 and 26. The schedule includes events in Maceió and Arapiraca, with meetings with political leaders and campaign activities. Gaspar also highlighted Lira's role in forming Flávio's ticket.

item.title: TSE proíbe Marçal de ter acesso ao fundo eleitoral e de ir a debates
item.description: The TSE prohibited Pablo Henrique Costa Marçal, from PRTB, from accessing electoral funding and participating in debates, maintaining the measure until his candidacy is judged on the merits. The decision responds to a request from the MPE, based on a conviction for misuse of social communication during municipal elections, which makes him ineligible until 2032.

item.title: Guimarães recorre a Alcolumbre para tentar destravar prioridades de Lula antes das eleições
item.description: Minister José Guimarães will seek out Davi Alcolumbre to expedite the approval of PECs on the 6×1 payroll scale and public security before the 2026 elections. The political coordination aims to advance these Lula government priorities in Congress. Guimarães plans to intensify efforts in September to push the legislative process for these issues.

item.title: Marçal está proibido de acessar fundo eleitoral e participar de debates, decide TSE
item.description: The TSE unanimously ruled that Pablo Marçal (PRTB) be temporarily barred from accessing electoral funds, participating in debates, and using free broadcast time while it reviews the PGE's request to disqualify him, deeming him ineligible until 2032.

item.title: Nantes desafia facções que tentam barrar campanha da direita em SP
item.description: Parliamentarian Sargento Nantes denounced alleged attempts by criminal factions to prevent the activity of right-wing candidates in Greater São Paulo communities, presenting communiqués and banners attributed to these groups. The complaint was made in a video posted on social media, highlighting restrictions on leafleting and campaign actions of parties allied to Governor Tarcísio.

item.title: "Quem tem que explicar é Lula", diz Flávio sobre caso Dark Horse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that President Lula should explain the Dark Horse case, not him, and questioned business influence in the government. During a street event in São Paulo, he criticized the PT and praised other opposition candidates like Pablo Marçal.

item.title: TSE veta acesso de Marçal a fundos eleitoral e partidário e participação em campanha na TV e debates
item.description: The TSE blocked Pablo Marçal's access to electoral and partisan funds and prohibited his participation in TV, radio campaigns and debates, maintaining the precautionary measure until the candidacy is analyzed. Marçal's ineligibility until 2032 was upheld due to a conviction for misuse of media, and the Public Ministry questions his party affiliation within the legal deadline.

item.title: Senador de oposição pede criação de ‘CPI do Lulinha’
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) requested the creation of a Senate CPI to investigate President Lula's son, Fábio Lula da Silva, accused of influence peddling. The case involves lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and businessman Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, already investigated for fraud in the INSS. Viana emphasized that the president's son is not above the law and is gathering support for the required signatures.

item.title: TSE impede Pablo Marçal de participar de debates, realizar propaganda e usar fundo eleitoral
item.description: The TSE unanimously ruled to bar Pablo Marçal (PRTB) from participating in debates, using electoral time, and accessing public campaign funds until his candidacy is reviewed. The measure is based on his ineligibility due to convictions related to the 2024 São Paulo municipal election. The expectation is for a final rejection of his candidacy registration.

item.title: Aliado de Ciro Gomes perde posto de vice-líder de Lula e culpa Camilo
item.description: Federal deputy Mauro Benevides Filho, an ally of Ciro Gomes, was removed from his position as Lula's deputy floor leader in the Chamber and blamed Senator Camilo Santana for the decision, due to the dispute in Ceará. Benevides supports Ciro, while Camilo supports Elmano de Freitas's re-election. Despite his support for Ciro, the deputy says he has always defended Lula's government in the Chamber.

item.title: Republicanos expulsa prefeito de Sorocaba por infidelidade partidária
item.description: The Republicanos party expelled Sorocaba's mayor, Rodrigo Manga, for publicly supporting his wife Sirlange Maganhato's candidacy for federal deputy under União Brasil in the 2026 elections, citing party infidelity. The decision was made unanimously by the party's National Ethics Council after Manga openly declared his support at União Brasil's headquarters.

item.title: Prefeita do PT ignora pressão e segue em campanha por Cleitinho em MG
item.description: Frei Gaspar's PT mayor, Jackeliny Nascimento, disregarded criticism from her state party president to publicly support Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), excluding PT's own gubernatorial nominee Patrus Ananias. Despite reprimands from Leninha, she promoted Cleitinho's campaign and celebrated the reach of posts featuring Lula, Cleitinho, and other politicians, sparking a crisis within the PT.

item.title: TSE proíbe presença de Pablo Marçal em debates e horário eleitoral em rádio e TV e veda acesso ao fundo que banca as campanhas
item.description: The TSE unanimously ruled that Pablo Marçal, PRTB presidential candidate, be barred from accessing electoral and party funds, as well as from participating in debates and electoral programming on radio and TV. The measure was adopted while the Court reviews the PGE's request to reject his candidacy for alleged ineligibility. The PGE argues that Marçal is serving an eight-year ineligibility period due to a conviction for misuse of communication media and challenges his affiliation with PRTB, as he is registered with the Brazilian Democratic Movement (MDB).

item.title: Deepfakes, Marçal e caso Master elevam temperatura da eleição de 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is debating whether to ban deepfakes and artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections, with most justices supporting a broad prohibition regardless of content. Cases involving Flávio Bolsonaro, such as a fake video of Jair Bolsonaro and leaked audio from Banco Master, are increasing pressure on the court. Pablo Marçal is also being discussed in the electoral context.

item.title: Em meio a campanha eleitoral, governo Lula deve ampliar limite de crédito para compra de carro por motoristas de aplicativo
item.description: The Lula administration plans to expand access to the Move Brasil program, which provides subsidized credit for vehicle purchases by ride-hailing and taxi drivers. With R$4 billion borrowed out of R$30 billion available, the government is pressuring private banks to release more loans. The measure takes place amid the 2026 electoral campaign.

item.title: Lulinha não é só mais um Silva
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign uses 'Rap do Silva' to emphasize his humble image, while the presence of his son, also named Lulinha, shows that the petista is no longer just another voter among millions of Brazilians with that surname. The strategy aims to strengthen the candidate's emotional connection with voters.

item.title: Articulador político de Lula vai pedir a Alcolumbre para acelerar tramitação de PECs
item.description: Minister José Guimarães will approach Alcolumbre to expedite the processing of Public Security and 6x1 scale PECs in the Senate. Although Alcolumbre authorized the advancement of the proposals, relator indications are still pending, leaving processing stalled. The Lula government seeks approval before elections to strengthen the re-election campaign.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio Bolsonaro, caso eleito, vai 'honrar' o fim da reeleição, em sabatina do GLOBO, CBN e Valor
item.description: Tarcísio supports Flávio Bolsonaro and claims he will honor the end of reelection, advocating for political reform to enable unpopular but necessary decisions without electoral pressure. Flávio previously proposed presidential ineligibility for the next term but recently suggested his government could last eight years.

item.title: Anúncio de show de Zezé Di Camargo troca dia 13 por ’12+1′
item.description: A concert poster for Zezé Di Camargo in Rio Verde (GO) drew attention by listing the date as '12+1 of November' instead of 'November 13th', prompting associations with the number 13 tied to the PT and Lula. The choice was made by the event production company, with no confirmation of political intent or direct involvement by the singer, who has publicly opposed the petista government.

item.title: Confira chaveamento da repescagem preliminar da Copa do Mundo Feminina 2027
item.description: FIFA set the draw for the preliminary round of the 2027 Women's World Cup qualification playoff. Six teams play three matches between November 24 and December 5, 2026, with two advancing to the final playoff phase, joining four directly qualified teams to secure the remaining three spots for the tournament in Brazil in 2027.

item.title: Lula viaja com Motta para agenda no RN uma semana após agenda com Alcolumbre no Amapá
item.description: President Lula travels to Rio Grande do Norte with Hugo Motta to strengthen congressional alliances and discuss priority measures, including the MP eliminating import taxes. The trip follows last week's agenda with Davi Alcolumbre in Amapá, reinforcing Lula's return to the legislative leadership ahead of elections. Pending congressional approval are security-related PECs, critical minerals legislation, and fiscal reforms.

item.title: Flávio enfrenta protesto contra Tarcísio em 1ª agenda em SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faced protests during his first campaign event in São Paulo, where demonstrators criticized Tarcísio de Freitas, toll prices, and police actions. The demonstration took place outside Mercadão de São Miguel with signs and chants of rejection.

item.title: Viana busca assinaturas para criar CPI do Lulinha no Senado
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) is collecting signatures to establish a Senate CPI investigating Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula. The initiative targets alleged irregularities involving the businessman's company.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio vê Marçal como freio a adversários na direita e mira aliança após possível decisão do TSE barrando candidatura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign sees Pablo Marçal's entry into the presidential race as a bigger obstacle for right-wing opponents, especially Renan Santos, and plans to bring him onto the ticket if the TSE blocks his candidacy. Meanwhile, the TSE has already restricted Marçal's participation in debates and electoral broadcasts pending a decision on his registration. His presence splits the conservative electorate, directly impacting smaller candidates like Renan.

item.title: Crusoé: PGR tenta tirar caso Lulinha do STF
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office requested that the Supreme Federal Court forward the investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, to a lower court. The case raises controversies, particularly due to involving members of the president's family.

item.title: Para 81% dos brasileiros, é fundamental que candidato acredite em Deus
item.description: A study by LePar shows that 81% of Brazilians believe it is essential for candidates to believe in God, especially among lower-income groups (89%). However, trust in religious institutions remains low, particularly in churches, and 54% of respondents oppose a secular state. The analysis also highlights how certain political forces have used religious values to support conservative ideological agendas.

item.title: Antes de ir a Minas e Rio, Lula desembarca no Rio Grande do Norte nesta quinta
item.description: President Lula arrives in Rio Grande do Norte for campaign activities, visiting the Augusto Severo Scientific Park and attending a rally with Cadu Xavier. He then proceeds to Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro for campaign events and policy announcements.

item.title: Manifestantes protestam contra Tarcísio durante agenda de Flávio Bolsonaro em SP
item.description: Protesters demonstrated against São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas during Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign stop in the city. The protest, held at the entrance of Mercadão de São Miguel, criticized police actions in communities, particularly raids targeting favela residents. Bolsonaro continued his schedule in São Paulo's eastern zone.

item.title: Como a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro pode levar o dólar a R$ 5,50?
item.description: JPMorgan analysis suggests the Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro race could push the dollar to R$5.50 in a fiscal deterioration scenario, or drop it to R$4.90 with fiscal adjustments. Public accounts and monetary policy will be the main factors watched by investors in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Cid Gomes lidera corrida ao Senado no Ceará, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey conducted from August 15 to 19, 2026, shows Cid Gomes (PSB) leading the race for the Senate in Ceará with 27% of voting intentions. Captain Wagner (União Brasil) and Luizianne Lins (Rede) are tied for second place, each with 21%. Voters will elect two senators in October.

item.title: Lula quer investigação sobre vazamentos de caso envolvendo filho, mas também defende depoimento rápido à PF
item.description: Lula calls for investigation into PF leaks and quick testimony from his son Fábio Luís, under investigation for alleged business mediation. The president criticizes selective leaks and seeks parallel scrutiny at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Vice de Haddad defende Marcola, investigado pela PF
item.description: The running mate for São Paulo governor in Fernando Haddad's (PT) ticket, Márcio França (PSB), publicly defended Marco Aurélio Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former chief of staff to President Lula (PT), after a meeting at the São Paulo Electoral Court. The statement drew attention as Marcola is under federal investigation.

item.title: Kaio Jorge, artilheiro do Cruzeiro, deixa Libertadores sem marcar gols
item.description: Kaio Jorge, the Cruzeiro top scorer this season with 13 goals, failed to score in the Copa Libertadores before elimination to Flamengo by 2-1 and faced fan criticism. Despite the blame, he created several chances in the match and assisted twice in the group stage. Cruzeiro now turns focus to the Copa do Brasil against Atlético-MG.

item.title: PGR pede a Mendonça que tire caso Lulinha do STF e leve à 1ª instância
item.description: The Brazilian Republic Prosecutor's Office requested that the case of businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, investigated for influence peddling at the Supreme Court, be returned to first instance. The PGR argues there is no privileged jurisdiction to justify the case remaining at the Supreme Court. The investigations are linked to fraud in the INSS and lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha enviou a Marcola minuta de contrato de R$ 626 mi com a Saúde
item.description: A draft contract worth R$626 million for the sale of 1.2 million cannabis oil bottles to the Ministry of Health, sent by Roberta Luchsinger to Marco Aurélio 'Marcola', was seized by Federal Police from suspects' phones. The deal, allegedly arranged without public bidding, was reportedly facilitated by lobbyist Antonio Carlos Camilo 'Careca do INSS', with suspicions of involvement by Fábio Lulinha, son of President Lula. Federal Police are investigating possible misconduct by the individuals involved with the federal government.

item.title: Falsa candidatura de Pablo Marçal foi feita para beneficiar Flávio, embora possa até ajudar Lula
item.description: Pablo Marçal's sham candidacy appears designed to benefit Flávio Bolsonaro, but may ultimately help Lula by delaying the race and reducing valid votes. Ineligibility until 2032 is clear, and the electoral courts are likely to annul the candidacy.

item.title: PGR pede que caso Lulinha deixe STF e vá pra 1ª instância, diz defesa
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office (PGR) requested that investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, be transferred to the first instance, claiming there is no special jurisdiction. Three inquiries investigate suspicions of influence peddling and corruption linked to the INSS discount scheme. Lulinha's defense states that the PGR also argued about the absence of privileged jurisdiction to justify the transfer.

item.title: Copa do Mundo Feminina 2027: Fifa define onde seleção brasileira jogará na fase de grupos
item.description: FIFA announced the host cities for Brazil's group stage matches in the 2027 Women's World Cup: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Brasília. Games will take place between June 24 and July 4, with the tournament opening at Maracanã Stadium.

item.title: Al-Fayha x Al-Hilal: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Al-Fayha and Al-Hilal face off at 3 PM (Brasília time) in the second round of the Saudi League 2026/27, broadcasted on Bandsports, XSports, and Canal GOAT. Al-Hilal enters as the favorite but faces attacking uncertainties with the possible departure of Karim Benzema and Salem Al-Dawsari's injury.

item.title: ‘Não há censura pela Justiça Eleitoral’, disse presidente do TRE de São Paulo
item.description: The president of the São Paulo Electoral Court stated there is no censorship in the Brazilian electoral system and defended candidates' freedom of expression. He emphasized the importance of complying with electoral laws and clarified that the judiciary does not censor but protects press and information freedom. Candidates signed a cooperation agreement to ensure transparency in the state election campaign.

item.title: Caso Lulinha: o jogo de empurra sobre acesso de lobista ao governo e a preocupação com desgaste para a campanha de Lula
item.description: The Lulinha case involves lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who allegedly posed as a representative of President Lula's son to gain access to the federal government. PT allies debate who should take responsibility for the incident, worrying about political damage to Lula's reelection. The Federal Police investigation aims to determine if Lulinha's name was used as a credential and who authorized the contact.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos à Presidência nesta quinta-feira
item.description: On Thursday (20), presidential candidates carry out campaign activities across multiple cities, including recordings, interviews, meetings, and political events. Key actions occur in São Paulo, Natal, Maceió, and São João del-Rei, with notable mentions of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula. The schedule reflects intensified pre-election debate for 2026.

item.title: Ministério Público pede rejeição de candidatura de Arruda no DF
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry requested the rejection of José Roberto Arruda's (PSD) candidacy for the DF government, arguing he is ineligible due to a 2018 conviction for administrative misconduct. The decision rests with the DF Electoral Regional Court, with the possibility of appeal to the TSE. In a recent survey, Arruda ranks second with 22% of voting intentions, behind Celina Leão (PP), who leads with 34%.

item.title: PGR quer que investigação contra filho de Lula saia da relatoria de André Mendonça no STF
item.description: Brazil's Attorney General (PGR) has requested that the Supreme Court remove investigations involving President Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger from Justice André Mendonça's oversight. The reasoning is that evidence collected by the Federal Police does not involve individuals with privileged forum. The case probes alleged influence peddling in a deal worth over R$ 600 million with the federal government.

item.title: 24 de 25 tribunais têm proporção de mulheres menor que no Brasil
item.description: A study by Justa found that in 24 out of 25 analyzed state courts, the proportion of female judges is lower than the percentage of women in the Brazilian population (51.5%). Only the Rio de Janeiro State Court exceeds this threshold. No court reaches gender parity among appellate judges, and only four states have women as court presidents. The study follows CNJ Resolution 525/2023, which established measures to increase women's representation in the second instance.
